question:
Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

'A state of temporary disuse or suspension.'
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Abeyance**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Abeyance"** refers to a state of temporary disuse, suspension, or inactivity. (अस्थायी निलंबन)
 
 
• **Example:** After the sudden resignation of the leader, the project was put in abeyance until a new manager was appointed.
 
 
• It is often used when something is halted temporarily, awaiting further action or decision.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Abeyance**.
